Database._comment: Overridden by the DATABASE_PATH environment variable in production. Must point to a persistent volume on the hosting platform.

Storage._comment: Overridden by the IMAGES_PATH environment variable in production.

Jwt._comment: Jwt:Key is intentionally NOT set here. Use 'dotnet user-secrets' in development and the Jwt__Key environment variable in production. See docs/architecture.md.

Cors._comment: List every origin the frontend is served from in production (e.g. the GitHub Pages URL). Empty in development: Program.cs falls back to http://localhost:4200.
